food_evidence.evidence: Intensifying sulforaphane formation in broccoli sprouts (2018)
food_evidence.limitations: Sulforaphane forms from glucoraphanin when sprouts are chopped or chewed; preparation affects the amount.

limitations: Human target engagement varies by formulation, tissue and population. The positive study used a myrosinase-completed broccoli sprout homogenate for three days in healthy nonsmokers and measured nasal phase II enzyme RNA, not Nrf2 protein or nuclear translocation. Extract capsules did not increase lung target-gene expression in COPD. An ordinary broccoli meal, direct activation of Nrf2 in the human brain and clinical ADHD benefit remain unestablished. Sulforaphane is not an essential nutrient.

mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Cell engagement does not itself establish dietary exposure; human preparation evidence assessed separately.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Existing canonical primary assessment; targeted primary retrieval in this run recorded separately.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Defined broccoli-sprout homogenate raised nasal phase-II gene RNA relative to the control preparation.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Nasal target-gene response, not brain/ADHD effect, universal serving response or direct measurement of Nrf2 activation in every tissue.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary abstract; precise preparation retained from prior full source assessment.

mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Different tissue, disease and formulation; prevents a uniform exposure-response claim.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Existing assessed primary null; targeted recheck recorded separately.

practices.input: Limit unnecessary cumulative heat exposure when retaining creatine in pork products
practices.biological_role: Controlled pork-loin and cooked-ham experiments found greater creatine-to-creatinine conversion with higher heat exposure, especially at the product surface.
practices.limitation: Evidence is limited to processed pork matrices and does not establish higher creatine intake or cerebral target engagement.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Heating protocols altered creatine-to-creatinine conversion in pork/ham materials.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Composition retention only, not brain effects; no advice to undercook food.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary abstract; DOI 10.1021/jf801953t verifies correction of mismatched bibliography PMID.

practices.exposure_qualification: Composition-preservation practice in tested pork products only; preserve food safety, no brain-efficacy or undercooking advice.

practices.pm_mission: Regulate the expression of cellular defence genes in response to oxidative and electrophilic stress.
practices.biological_role: Three daily doses of broccoli sprouts, blended with water and daikon sprouts and held at 37°C so myrosinase could finish forming sulforaphane, increased phase II enzyme RNA in nasal cells of healthy adults. The authors read that shared pattern as Nrf2-linked induction. They did not measure Nrf2 protein or its movement into the nucleus.
practices.limitation: This is three days of that homogenate in healthy adults and nasal enzyme RNA, not brain Nrf2, an ordinary broccoli serving, or the four-week sprout-extract capsules that did not raise lung target-gene expression in COPD.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Defined broccoli-sprout homogenate raised nasal phase-II gene RNA relative to the control preparation.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Nasal target-gene response, not brain/ADHD effect, universal serving response or direct measurement of Nrf2 activation in every tissue.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary abstract; precise preparation retained from prior full source assessment.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: The COPD capsule trial did not increase the assessed Nrf2 target-gene endpoints.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Different tissue, disease and formulation; prevents a uniform exposure-response claim.
